name: Telescopic Sight
effect: +1 to aim (slow action); +2 from stable platform (rest/sandbag/bipod)

name: Night Vision Sight
effect: No darkness penalty within MEDIUM range; SHORT range without IR light

name: Bayonet
effect: Allows military rifle to be used effectively in melee

name: Bipod
effect: Stable firing platform; mountable on rifles and LMGs/GPMGs

name: Tripod
effect: Required for HMGs and some ATGMs (e.g. TOW) unless vehicle mounted

name: Suppressor
effect: Reduces report sound; harder to pinpoint origin. Requires compatible barrel

name: AN/PRC-148 MBITR
effect: Multiband handheld; interoperable with US/NATO radios

name: AN/PRC-77
effect: VHF FM backpack radio; accepts KY-57 encryption device

name: AN/PRC-119 SINCGARS
effect: Frequency hopping across 2,320 channels; encrypted or clear transmission

name: KY-57 VINSON
effect: Voice encryption device; attaches to compatible radios via cable

name: R-105M
effect: Older FM manpack; found in third-line and Warsaw Pact units

name: R-107
effect: Replaced R-105M; used in third-line and rear-echelon units

name: R-126
effect: Platoon/company FM radio; 31 fixed channels

name: R-311
effect: Shortwave AM; Morse code; EMP resistant. No transistors — widely available

name: R-392A
effect: Six preset FM channels; includes hand-crank power option

name: R-198
effect: Latest Soviet platoon-level radio; 30–80 MHz FM

name: Walkie-Talkie
effect: Single FM channel; advanced models may have multiple channels or encryption

name: Ham Radio
effect: HF AM; Morse/voice; global range possible with antenna. Rel 2–4 by model

name: Signal Panels
effect: Reversible nylon; signals aircrews or visually IDs friendly units at distance

name: Strobe Light
effect: Bright blinking light; IR cap option visible only through night vision devices

name: Signal Flare
effect: Signaling only — no illumination. Single-use canister or reusable launcher

name: — Range note —
effect: Vehicle-mounted or long-wire antenna doubles range. TECH roll can double range for one shift.

name: Binoculars
effect: +2 to RECON when actively scouting or observing

name: Night Vision Goggles
effect: Night vision to 3 hexes (30m); 5 hexes with IR light. Eliminates darkness penalties to RANGED COMBAT and RECON. Requires battery

name: Thermal Optics
effect: Sees heat through fog, rain, and smoke. Eliminates all darkness/weather/smoke penalties. Extremely rare

name: Flashlight
effect: Illuminates 3 hexes (30m); highly visible. IR cover variant exists. Requires small battery

name: Searchlight
effect: Illuminates 10 hexes (100m); requires vehicle, large battery, or generator

name: Compass
effect: +2 to SURVIVAL for navigating in roadless terrain

name: GPS
effect: Eliminates SURVIVAL navigation roll when functional. Rolls 4+ on D6 to work — many satellites destroyed. Very rare

name: Radiacmeter
effect: Detects radiation level in area; slow action to use

name: Chemical Agent Detector
effect: Detects and identifies chemical agents in hex; one stretch to use

name: Protective Mask
effect: Removes –3 STAMINA penalty vs chemical weapons; –2 to RECON and STAMINA (marching)

name: HAZMAT/MOPP Suit
effect: Full chemical protection when worn with Protective Mask; some radiation protection

name: Raingear
effect: +1 STAMINA vs chemical weapons

name: Personal Medkit
effect: +1 to MEDICAL AID; disposable, single use

name: Doctor's Medical Kit
effect: +2 to MEDICAL AID; includes 10 doses of each drug type, bandages, minor surgery tools

name: Surgical Instruments
effect: +1 to MEDICAL AID for fatal critical injuries only; combinable with medkits

name: Antibiotics
effect: +3 MEDICAL AID vs infected wounds/bacterial infections; one dose lasts one day

name: Pain Reliever
effect: Heals 1 damage per stretch; further doses same shift have no effect

name: Atropine Autoinjector
effect: Treats nerve agent effects; single dose, disposable, no medical training required

name: Basic Tools
effect: General repair and vehicle servicing; wrenches, pliers, screwdrivers

name: Vehicle Tools
effect: +1 to repairing/servicing vehicles; specialized set

name: Weapon Tools
effect: +1 to repairing weapons; specialized set

name: Weapon Spare Part
effect: Required to repair inoperable weapon; usable for jury rigging

name: Vehicle Spare Part
effect: Required to repair inoperable vehicle

name: Electronic Spare Part
effect: Required to repair inoperable electronic item

name: General Spare Part
effect: Required to repair inoperable mechanical item (non-weapon/vehicle); usable for jury rigging

name: Gasoline/Diesel
effect: Traditional fossil fuel; very rare in Europe, 2000

name: Alcohol Fuel
effect: Produced from wood/grain/organics; most vehicles already converted

name: Small Still
effect: Produces up to 5 liters/shift; 1 enc unit organic material per liter. Jury riggable (20 spare parts)

name: Large Still
effect: Produces up to 50 liters/shift; 1 enc unit organic material per liter. Jury riggable (400 spare parts)

name: Industrial Still
effect: Produces up to 500 liters/shift; stationary, cannot be moved

name: Small Generator
effect: Powers one small device; 2 liters alcohol/shift or manual STAMINA roll. Jury riggable (3 spare parts + 4 electronic)

name: Large Generator
effect: Powers one large or up to 12 small devices; 20 liters alcohol/shift. Jury riggable (30 spare parts + 40 electronic)

name: Small Battery
effect: Powers one small device for one day; recharge via vehicle or generator in one shift

name: Car Battery
effect: Powers one large or up to 12 small devices for one day; recharge via vehicle or large generator in one shift

name: Plastic Explosives
effect: Blast D at ¼ enc unit; quadrupling amount raises blast one step (max A)

name: Dynamite Sticks
effect: Blast D per stick; quadrupling raises blast one step (max A)

name: Chemicals
effect: Raw material; 1 unit converts to 1 unit improvised explosives via TECH roll

name: Improvised Explosives
effect: Blast D at 1 enc unit; quadrupling raises blast one step (max A). Failed TECH roll: roll again — second failure = immediate detonation

name: Field Rations (MRE)
effect: Self-contained; 3+ year shelf life; covers full daily food requirement

name: Domestic Food
effect: Cooked meat or vegetables; spoils within one week

name: Wild Food
effect: Foraged plants and roots; spoils after one week; low energy content

name: Backpack
effect: Carry extra enc units = STR die size; –2 to all MOBILITY rolls while worn

name: Fatigues
effect: Camouflage; adequate cold protection (not severe winter); +1 RECON for ambushes and staying hidden

name: Thermal Fatigues
effect: Protection against extreme cold

name: Sleeping Bag
effect: +2 to SURVIVAL sleeping on bare ground and STAMINA vs cold

name: Blanket
effect: +1 to STAMINA vs cold

name: Small Tent
effect: +1 to SURVIVAL for making camp; fits 4 people

name: Large Tent
effect: +1 to SURVIVAL for making camp; fits 10 people

name: Fishing Gear
effect: Used for fishing; jury riggable with 1 general spare part
